result.explanation: Canonicalize each event value recursively: arrays retain order, objects sort keys lexically, and scalar JSON types remain distinct. This directly satisfies the encoding contract.
result.mapping: The input value maps to output.key. State is unused and remains null.
result.assumptions: Inputs obey the stated JSON-value, depth, safe-number, and string restrictions. No external data or mutable history is needed.
result.program: function esc(s){var r='"';for(var i=0;i<s.length;i++){var c=s.charCodeAt(i);if(c===34)r+='\\"';else if(c===92)r+='\\\\';else if(c===8)r+='\\b';else if(c===12)r+='\\f';else if(c===10)r+='\\n';else if(c===13)r+='\\r';else if(c===9)r+='\\t';else if(c<32){var h=c.toString(16);r+='\\u'+('0000'+h).slice(-4);}else r+=s[i];}return r+'"';}function enc(v){if(v===null)return'null';var t=typeof v;if(t==='string')return esc(v);if(t==='boolean'||t==='number')return JSON.stringify(v);if(Array.isArray(v)){var a=[];for(var i=0;i<v.length;i++)a.push(enc(v[i]));return'['+a.join(',')+']';}var k=Object.keys(v).sort(),a=[];for(var j=0;j<k.length;j++)a.push(esc(k[j])+':'+enc(v[k[j]]));return'{'+a.join(',')+'}';}function solve(x){return{state:null,output:{key:enc(x.event.value)}};}
